curated-gf-pochaevsk-gf-noto-sans-sinhal: Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a dark, sturdy stripe of text under Pochaevsk. Its curve endings keep their distance, so a long page moves along smoothly, while the heading's half-open a's add a bit of character for, say, a team schedule card.
curated-gf-poetsen-one-archivo: Chunky, tight-lipped headlines meet open-handed text. Poetsen One is happiest shouting a few big words with its closed-in counters, whereas Archivo, with its tall x-height and outward-opening curves, takes over once sentences need room to unfold.
curated-gf-poetsen-one-gf-noto-sans-psal: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping e's and capitals that barely rise above the line. It stays approachable over a stretch of text, and Poetsen One, with its tall middle band and shallow ascenders, supplies the tight, chunky punch above.
curated-gf-poller-one-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads bookish and gentle, its wide channels leading into each counter. Poller One earns its keep up top, where its stout stems and hairline crossbars can swing hard across a few big words.
curated-gf-pompiere-author: Pompiere has small-lowercase proportions and a tightly knit string of letters, with curves ending in clear daylight. Author follows with a slight swell in its bowls, a dignified classic serif that could carry, say, a bakery sign.
curated-gf-ponnala-gf-hind-siliguri: Huddled letters drawn like outlines in a single width give Ponnala its look. It does best at brief, loud moments, such as a pocket knife and tools label, while Hind Siliguri, with its cracked-bangle rounds, handles the quieter running copy.
curated-gf-poor-story-gf-pt-mono: Poor Story draws every curve with open jaws and hairline gaps, one rod-like width throughout. It is built to announce, whereas PT Mono, with its fixed-width, loosely tracked letters, suits something structured, say, a regex cheat sheet.
curated-gf-poor-story-gf-reddit-mono: Rod-thin lines and gaping curves, then rigid monospace. Poor Story brings expressive swagger, and Reddit Mono keeps everything on a fixed grid with a spacious c (handy for a kubernetes dashboard).
curated-gf-potta-one-gf-varela-round: Varela Round reads modern and soft, its rounds wide-mouthed and its strokes uniform. Potta One brings the wire-like monoline swagger and extra-wide spacing that make the pair memorable.
curated-gf-praise-gf-spectral-sc: Spectral SC is literary and bookish, with sturdy hairlines. Praise leans in with tight, thick-and-thin handwriting, and its closed letters play against the body's wide mouths (say, on a confetti new year poster).
